test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won the gold medal at International Weightlifting Federation's youth world championship in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurunaidu Sanapathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gurunaidu Sanapathi **won the **gold medal** at **International Weightlifting Federation's youth world championship** in** June 2022**.
 
• At the IWF Youth World Championships held in Leon, Mexico, Indian weightlifter Saanapathi Gurunaidu clinched the gold medal in the men’s 55-kilogram category event.
 
• Additionally, on the opening day of the IWF competition, two other Indian weightlifters, Vijay Prajapati and Akanksha Kishor Vyavhare, secured silver medals.
 
• Saanapathi achieved a total lift of 230 kilograms, earning him the gold medal in the men’s 55-kilogram event. He secured the silver medal in the Snatch category with a lift of 104 kg and the gold medal in the Clean and Jerk category with a lift of 126 kilograms.
 
• Vijay, competing in the Men’s 49-kilogram event, lifted a total of 175 kilograms, securing the second position. In the Snatch category, he lifted 78 kilograms, while in the Clean and Jerk category, he lifted 97 kilograms.
 
• In the Women’s 40-kilogram division, Akanksha claimed the gold medal. She achieved a total lift of 127 kilograms, earning her the silver medal after finishing first in the Snatch section with a lift of 59 kilograms and third in the Clean and Jerk section with a lift of 68 kilograms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The IWF Youth World Championships** is organized by the International Weightlifting Federation (IWF).
 
• The inaugural competition took place in** May 2009**, marking the beginning of this prestigious event.
 
• The upcoming edition of the Youth World Weightlifting Championships is scheduled to be held in Lima, Peru, in 2024.
 
• Previously, the 2023 Youth World Weightlifting Championships were hosted in Durrës, Albania, from March 25 to April 1, 2023.
 
• Similarly, the 2022 championships were held in León, Mexico, from June 11 to 18, 2022.
